title: 25 mm box-X bartack proof at the BL-010 per-row loads

steps: sew the loops exactly like the pack (necks folded and tacked first); loop over the 5 mm pin; 5 loops to 908 N (92.6 kg) and 5 to 1080 N (110.1 kg); the 2 IMC tabs (cam bar on a 5 mm pin each end) to 908 N; the 2 USA anchors (necked loop on a 5 mm pin, cam bar in the other) to 1080 N; hold 1 min each

title: 25 mm cam buckle slip at the BL-010 per-row loads, dry, wet and cold

A home freezer at -18 C or colder is ACCEPTED as the record's -20 C (ASSUMPTION FREEZER)

title: HE hinge eye on B-18 + B-01 + B-05 floor seam, sewn as op 4.05 (HE-ONE / HE-PIN), no binding
steps: FIXTURE: a fresh print of `print/frame_h1/test_pieces/hefit_hinge_fairlead_R.stl` (not the HE-FIT piece), eye reamed to 7.2, its UHMWPE sleeve, bolted upright to the bench plate through the stay segment; flat spacer plate (PLA, or 6 mm ply shimmed) screwed to the printed stay segment, its face flush with the cheek tips (17.7 mm proud of the stay surface) from the cheeks down past the box, so B-01 is HELD at the cheek-tip plane and the box cannot swing in line: leg B leaves the box top at the worst peel angle (he_peel 'tip_plane'). The pin centre is then 7.6 mm toward the frame from the B-01 face and 14 mm above the box top (the bag geometry, DECISION HE-ENV). Put the the hardened steel M5 x 40 dowel (DIN 6325 m6, HRC 58-62; NOT a 7075 frame pin) through cheek, sleeve, eye, cheek (only the 18 mm neck between the cheeks); clamp the B-05 strip ALONE in the bar clamp below; the B-01 top edge stays FREE (never clamped: a clamp there carries the load past the floor seam); pull DOWN along the spacer face (leg B leaves the box top at about 50 deg: the peel the frame gives) to 1530 N (156.0 kg); hold 60 s; with the loupe check the box TOP row first, then the neck tacks and the floor seam. PIN CHECK (BL-048 M-C): roll the dowel on the bench plate before and after the test: it rolls freely with no visible wobble and a 0.05 mm feeler does not pass under its middle; a bent pin voids the specimen. If the printed cheeks crack before the eye fails, the specimen is void: re-run it in a machined aluminium copy of the same section (ASSUMPTION PT3-PRINT). PRINT (BL-048 m-6): fixtures print as the H1 frame: PAHT-CF, dried, the H1 slicer settings (print/frame_h1/README.md), annealed as H1.
pass: 5 of 5 hold 1530 N 60 s: no stitch break (box top row included), no Hypalon or laminate tear, B-18 still in the floor seam, the eye still open (no row across it)

title: hinge eye 1:1 dry fit on the printed BL-042 z 60 hinge fairlead (eye on the pin, neck in the throat)
gates: hinge eye on the z 60 pin of the printed BL-042 hinge fairlead, 1:1 dry fit before PT-3 and before cut (BL-041 X-2, BL-044 DECISION HE-ENV); step 0 = gate US-ROUTE on the US test piece (BL-048 N-1)
steps: (0) US ROUTE (BL-048, fourth review N-1; pass criterion below): print the US test piece `test_kit/print/us_route_stay_R.stl` (R stay z 40-160 with the hinge, US1 and US2 fairleads, cut from `h1_assembled.stl` by `us_route.export_test_piece`; print it as the H1 frame: PAHT-CF, dried, H1 settings, annealed) and clamp it upright; sew two USA anchors (25 mm, as op 7.16: the piece is the R stay, where the cam anchors sit) and hang the HE specimen of this test on its hinge pin (the hardened steel M5 x 40 dowel (DIN 6325 m6, HRC 58-62; NOT a 7075 frame pin) in each fairlead); USA on the US1 pin, its cam on a 25 mm strap laid down the B-01 offcut over the piece, round a 20 mm dowel at the floor-seam line (the floor corner, 25 mm under the hinge pin) to the crane scale, cinched to 444 N (45.3 kg); then the same from the US2 pin at 296 N (30.2 kg); repeat with the IME eye on the IM3-EC piece pulled at -82 to -88 deg (the sim directions). PASS (gate US-ROUTE): at the cinched load, along its whole run from the eye to the dowel, no part of the strap, eye or box touches the hinge fairlead, the HE (eye, legs or box) or the other US fairlead: a 10 mm feeler block passes between them everywhere (the design clearance is >= 10 mm). FAIL = any contact or a gap under 10 mm. On the CURRENT print this step FAILS by design (us_route.json: the strap lies over the hinge cheeks and the HE box, 1-4.5 mm into them, bearing about 224 N): it is the evidence for the US station move asked of BL-047, and is re-run on the re-cut piece once the US fairleads are on their lanes (US1 x 70, US2 x 165); the bag is not cut until it passes; (1) re-caliper ONE ply of the 38 mm roll in hand at 5 places (the first caliper is at the PURCHASE, on a sample, shopping list; BL-048 M-B): every reading <= 1.6 mm, else reject the roll (3 plies of a thicker web leave < 0.7 mm under the pin); (2) clamp the printed stay segment upright; (3) slide the neck round the pin by hand: the pin goes through cheek, sleeve, eye, cheek with the eye seated, no forcing; then push the neck hard against each cheek in turn and slide it round the pin again (its folded edge passes the printed throat-corner fillet: 0.3 mm clear on the model, BL-044 he_stl_check); (4) hang 5 kg from the B-05 strip so the eye loads the pin; (5) caliper from the floor seam line to the pin centre; (6) feeler gauge between the box top and the cheeks' lower edge; (7) check the eye is not folded over the box and the neck is not pinched by the cheeks; photo
pass: ply <= 1.6 mm; pin centre 22-29 mm above the floor seam line; >= 2 mm feeler between the box top and the cheeks; the eye slides round the pin by hand; neck alone in the 20 mm throat; eye points up (no fold-down)

title: guy + crown-strap toggles in the 38 mm B-25 sleeve on the real crown bar, 497 N
gates: B-25 38 mm sleeve + guy and crown-strap toggles on the real crown bar at 497 N, guy pulled 57 deg below horizontal and 14 % outboard, spine end anchored (BL-045 record, crown_and_fairlead_checks.json; BL-048 M-A)
steps: clamp the tube ends in V-blocks >= 40 mm outside the sleeve edges (the bar reacts as a beam), NO cradle or saddle under the sleeve; anchor the run's spine end (the stub, bolted, as the specimen) so the drop leg loads the sleeve as on the frame; dial bore gauge 10-18 mm range, 0.01 mm, >= 110 mm reach (BL-043 m-7: basis A predicts dD at the LOOP CENTRE; the gauge goes in through the open outboard tube end, anvils on the pull axis at the sleeve centre, depth marked on the shaft; zero it on the unloaded tube); PULL VECTOR (BL-045 record, crown_and_fairlead_checks.json): the guy toggle pulled 57 deg below horizontal and 14 % outboard (unit vector: down 0.84, aft 0.52, outboard 0.14; set the come-along anchor 1 m from the toggle at 841 mm below, 524 mm aft and 136 mm outboard of it, and check the angle with a phone inclinometer on the line); the crown-strap toggle sits in the tab UNLOADED (in the record its pull is up and aft and takes load off the bar, so leaving it slack is conservative); pull in steps 100 / 200 / 300 / 400 / 497 N (50.7 kg), reading the gauge at each step; hold 497 N 60 s, listening (phone microphone on the tube); unload, remove the sleeve, micrometer the loop centre at 0 and 90 deg; check the mitre and the run did not slip (pen marks across the fold and at the stub); loupe + tap test against the control; repeat 1 sample after 4 h in the freezer (POM)
pass: 5 of 5: (1) holds 497 N 60 s, toggle does not pull through or crack, no broken stitch; (2) no crackle; (3) gauge at 497 N within 1.15 x the straight line through the 100-300 N readings, no knee; (4) ovalisation at the LOOP CENTRE (bore gauge, BL-043 m-7) <= 0.40 mm at 497 N (basis A 0.39, B 0.2, C 0.005 mm, all at the loop centre); (5) out-of-round after unloading <= 0.02 mm more than before; (6) no crush mark, whitening or resin crack at 10x, tap test clean; the cold sample holds

steps: loop over a 5 mm pin on the lever (in place of a coupon), the free end in the bar clamp; set the crank so the cell swings 11 -> 110 N (4:1 lever = 44 -> 442 N on the loop); 1 Hz to 100,000 cycles (27.8 h); loupe check at 25,000 / 50,000 / 75,000; after run-out pull the loop on the G2 bench to 1080 N (the MT-1 US proof), 1 min. HE (BL-044; mounting BL-048 m-6, G4 rig sketch): the printed fairlead + spacer (the PT-3 fixture, the hardened steel M5 x 40 dowel (DIN 6325 m6, HRC 58-62; NOT a 7075 frame pin)) bolted to the lever rig's FIXED base plate at the coupon station, in place of the coupon block, stay segment upright under the lever's clamp; the B-05 strip in the lever's moving bar clamp (the fixture grip never holds the fabric), the pull straight down the spacer face as PT-3; cell 16 -> 156 N (62 -> 625 N on the eye), 1 Hz to 100,000 cycles, loupe on the box TOP row; after run-out, the PT-3 proof 1530 N 60 s. PIN CHECK (BL-048 M-C): roll the dowel on the bench plate before and after the test: it rolls freely with no visible wobble and a 0.05 mm feeler does not pass under its middle; a bent pin voids the specimen. PRINT (BL-048 m-6): fixtures print as the H1 frame: PAHT-CF, dried, the H1 slicer settings (print/frame_h1/README.md), annealed as H1.
pass: loops: 3 of 3 run-outs to 1e5 at 442 N, no broken stitch, then hold 1080 N 1 min; HE: 3 of 3 run-outs to 1e5 at 625 N with no broken stitch in the box top row, then hold 1530 N 60 s (a 2 of 3 result in either set: run 3 more of that set, pass with 5 of 6)
